extracted.intended_audience: writers seeking publication (literary fiction and narrative nonfiction) at Catapult
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance describing the kinds of book-length literary fiction and artful narrative nonfiction Catapult seeks: work that challenges perception, honors craft, and often comes from historically underrepresented voices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engages with the 'Perception Box' concept
rubrics_metrics.description: Work should engage with our Perception Box, the metaphor Catapult uses to define the structure and boundaries of how we see others in their full humanity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should 'invite new ways of seeing and being seen' and explicitly or implicitly interrogate the limits of perception and empathy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre: literary fiction and artful narrative nonfiction
rubrics_metrics.description: Catapult publishes literary fiction and artful narrative nonfiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer book-length work in these genres rather than genre fiction or strictly journalistic accounts; emphasis on literary qualities and narrative craftsmanship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prose qualities: alive, insightful, illuminating, surprising
rubrics_metrics.description: Our books are alive, insightful, illuminating, and surprising.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Writing should feel vital and offer fresh, illuminating perspectives or discoveries rather than flat or predictable prose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voice: vital voices that honor craft
rubrics_metrics.description: Written by vital voices—emerging and established—that honor the craft of writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catapult values skilled, attentive writing and strong authorial voice; both newer and established authors are considered if they demonstrate craft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Challenges assumptions and biases
rubrics_metrics.description: We embrace writers and audiences who fearlessly shake up our assumptions and biases; and who believe in the power of storytelling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should confront, unsettle, or complicate readers' preconceived notions rather than reinforce easy or comfortable views.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explores liminal or between-the-lines spaces
rubrics_metrics.description: We celebrate stories that explore the space between the lines of our lives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that focuses on nuance, ambiguity, and the subtle or overlooked aspects of experience is prized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prefers works that raise questions rather than give answers
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories that raise questions rather than give answers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narratives should invite reflection and ambiguity instead of delivering neat resolutions or didactic messages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seeks work that rattles the walls of the Perception Box
rubrics_metrics.description: We celebrate stories that rattle the walls of our Perception Box—expanding the boundaries of who we think we are, and what we think we know.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for books that broaden readers' understanding of identity, experience, and knowledge.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publishes historically underrepresented and diverse voices
rubrics_metrics.description: We work with a diverse list of writers who have been historically underrepresented, broadening the literary landscape in the United States and beyond.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catapult actively seeks to publish voices that diversify the literary ecosystem; submissions from underrepresented authors are a stated priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embraces writing that requires effort from writer and reader
rubrics_metrics.description: We embrace writing that requires an effort on the part of both writer and reader to reach beyond our assumptions and biases to see the humanity, struggle, and truth in every human being.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expectations include conceptual or structural complexity that rewards careful reading and thoughtful creation—work need not be facile or immediately digestible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to publishing with care, intention, and respect for authors
rubrics_metrics.description: We are committed to publishing with care, intention, and respect for our authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although this is a publisher-side standard rather than a submission criterion, it signals a collaborative editorial approach and implies expectations of professionalism and mutual respect during the publishing process.
